_: THE SWEEP THAT SAYS A DOCUMENT READER BEHIND THE CITATION PORT IS NOT
VACUOUS — run it from the repository root:
cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/injection-harness/Cargo.toml -- sweep \
crates/mnemosyne-cli/sweeps/inventory-marker.sweep.json
WHAT THE CONTRACT IS. `inventory_attributes` and `inventory_elements` declare
XML names, each of which builds a READER behind `CitationExtractor` (Round
1328). A reader answers WHERE the citations are — never whether one is
missing or deprecated, which is the gate's judgment against the store. The
attribute reader reads an attribute's value, the element reader an element's
own text, both split on whitespace, both named by namespace URI rather than
prefix, and a declared document that will not parse is reported with the
parser's reason rather than read as citing nothing.
EIGHTEEN INJECTIONS. Ten are the reader's own grammar (namespace, the parsed
value, the unreadable document in the extractor and in the scan, the reason,
the one reader, the raw text, the extension filter, the DOCTYPE, the line
walk). Four are the reach report (every document counted as carrying, a bare
document not counted as read, not named, the report's key). Two are the port
itself: a declared element list that builds no reader, and an element reader
that reads its descendants' text as its own. Two more are the line a person
reads and the id's own line.
THE DECLARATION'S OWN REFUSALS are swept next door, in
crates/mnemosyne-config/sweeps/inventory-attribute-declaration.sweep.json.
RUN IT LOCALLY. The harness edits this tree and writes the firing record
beside this file.

injections.name: an-attribute-is-matched-by-local-name-alone
injections.why: the prefix-versus-namespace confusion the axis exists to remove: any attribute spelled `req` is read, whatever namespace its prefix is bound to

injections.name: a-value-is-read-as-raw-text
injections.why: the raw text read instead of the value XML defines, so an id written through an entity never decodes

injections.name: an-unreadable-document-is-skipped-by-the-reader
injections.why: a document that will not parse read as citing nothing — indistinguishable from a document that cites nothing

injections.name: the-scan-drops-an-unreadable-document
injections.why: the reader returns it and the gate never turns it into a violation — the same silence one layer up

injections.name: the-parser-reason-is-dropped
injections.why: the violation says a document could not be read and not why, so a consumer re-parses the file to learn what the gate saw

injections.name: the-one-reader-consults-no-reader
injections.why: the readers are declared, built and reported, and the one reader never asks any of them — the shape a caller that did not take the port would have

injections.name: the-caller-ignores-what-a-reader-asked-for
injections.why: every reader handed the document whatever it declared, so a prefix axis reads a citation-shaped token out of a string literal — the caller owns the comment filter and this is it failing to apply it

injections.name: a-document-of-any-extension-is-read
injections.why: every file in the read set handed to every reader, so a Markdown example becomes a citation and every source file becomes an unreadable document

injections.name: a-prefix-reader-is-handed-the-document
injections.why: Round 1329's reason for letting a reader declare its text: a prefix axis handed the whole document reads a citation-shaped token out of a string literal or a data file, which is what `comment_only` exists to stop

injections.name: a-prefix-list-builds-no-reader
injections.why: the opaque-id axis declared and never built — every inventory citation in a code comment goes unread while the config says the axis is on

injections.name: a-declared-program-builds-no-reader
injections.why: the port's last step declared and never built: a workspace names its own parser as the reader and the gate runs none of it, reading nothing while the config says otherwise

injections.name: a-reader-is-handed-its-input-on-a-pipe
injections.why: THE DEFECT ROUND 1331 SHIPPED AND ROUND 1334 REPAID, put back exactly. A reader may answer from the path and never read its input, and `mnemosyne-cli` restores SIG_DFL for SIGPIPE (Round 859) so a piped report dies like `cat` — so the gate's own write to a reader that has exited KILLS THE GATE mid-scan: empty stdout, empty stderr, nothing to read. On a pipe it is a race the fast machine wins, which is why it passed two local root suites and one of the two hosted jobs of the same commit; against the half-megabyte document it is certain

edits.from:
.spawn()
            .map_err(|why| format!("`{}` could not be run: {why}", argv.join(" ")))?;

injections.name: a-program-that-fails-is-read-as-citing-nothing
injections.why: the failure this axis exists to refuse, at the newest reader: a program that cannot be run, exits non-zero, prints nonsense or hangs is treated as a document with no citations, which is exactly what a clean document looks like

injections.name: a-program-may-outstay-its-time
injections.why: no deadline on a declared program, so one that hangs hangs every run that reads a document it is declared for — and a gate that can hang is a gate people turn off

injections.name: an-element-list-builds-no-reader
injections.why: the port's second reader declared and never built — the axis reads attributes only while the config says otherwise, in silence

injections.name: an-element-reader-reads-its-descendants-text
injections.why: a nested element's text read as its ancestor's citation, so one annotation cites every element it sits under

injections.name: every-document-is-reported-as-carrying-the-attribute
injections.why: the coverage report says every document it read carries what the reader reads, so an adopter whose documents carry none of it is told the opposite of the truth

injections.name: a-document-that-carries-nothing-is-not-counted-as-read
injections.why: only documents that carry something are counted as read, so `0 of 0` replaces `0 of N` and a document read and found bare is indistinguishable from one never opened

injections.name: a-bare-document-is-counted-but-not-named
injections.why: the report says how many documents carry none of it and never which, so an adopter still has to search the tree for the ones written another way

injections.name: the-line-a-person-reads-omits-the-reach
injections.why: the wire says a reader reached nothing and the line a person reads does not — the Round 1045 defect, one axis over

edits.from: " — NO DOCUMENT CARRIES IT, so this axis judged nothing"

injections.name: the-report-omits-the-reader-axis
injections.why: the coverage is computed and never published, which is the silence Round 1326 exists to remove

injections.name: a-doctype-makes-a-document-unreadable
injections.why: the parser's default refusal of a DTD left in place, so an ordinary XML document carrying a document type declaration is reported unreadable instead of read

injections.name: the-walk-that-attributes-a-line-does-not-move-forward
injections.why: Round 1324's cursor: an id spelled through an entity leaves the walk where it was, so a later id whose text occurs inside that entity reference is reported on the entity's line

injections.name: an-id-carries-its-holders-line-not-its-own
injections.why: every id of a multi-line list reported at the line its attribute or element opened on, which points a reader at a line the id is not on
